question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Consensus for Apple's Sept-quarter FY26 diluted EPS is $1.99 (range 1.93-2.07). Apple's guidance (rev +9-11%, GM 47-48% incl ~1pt tariff refund, opex $19.1-19.4B, OI&E ~$0.35B, tax ~16.5%, ~14.65B shares) gives about $1.97 at midpoint and about $2.07 at the top end. Apple beat EPS in 8 of the last 8 quarters, usually by 3-7% (Q3 FY26 $2.02 vs $1.89), so the median is set above consensus at about $2.05. Downside comes from memory costs, iPhone supply constraints and FX. A small left tail covers a one-off tax charge like the Q4 FY24 EU charge that cut EPS to $0.97. No prediction market was found on Kalshi, Polymarket, Manifold or bookmakers.
